rav-giddel.name: Rav Giddel
rav-giddel.bio: Babylonian Amora, a disciple of Rav whose rulings he often transmits.
rav-giddel.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a steady, attentive expression, as if repeating his teacher’s ruling word for word; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rabba-bar-yosef.name: Rabba bar Yosef
rabba-bar-yosef.bio: Babylonian Amora cited transmitting a ruling of Rav.
rabba-bar-yosef.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a careful, reciting expression; background of palm groves along the Euphrates.

avimi.name: Avimi
avimi.bio: Babylonian Amora and teacher of Rav Ḥisda, who once forgot a tractate and went to his student to relearn it (Menaḥot 7a).
avimi.prompt: A dignified, humble elder in his 70s with a white beard and a gentle, searching expression, as if asking a former student to remind him of a teaching; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.
